Findings: Codex CLI 0.154.0 is installed on this machine via Homebrew cask (/opt/homebrew/bin/codex -> Caskroom/codex/0.154.0, symlink dated 2026-09-15 12:52) and resolves from a login shell (`zsh -lc 'codex --version'` -> codex-cli 0.154.0); it is NOT on the non-login PATH the Bash tool uses, so hook/host tests must invoke it via `zsh -lc` or the absolute path. This is the same version source-evidence.md cites for the field's evaluation environment.; The two drafted W2 plans (docs/plans/2026-09-08-2.17.0-w2-implementation.md, 2026-09-08-2.17.1-implementation.md) were never committed — untracked in the working tree alongside the Codex-plugin work (AGENTS.md, docs/CODEX.md, docs/plans/2026-09-09-codex-plugin.md, plugins/, scripts/build-codex-plugin.mjs, scripts/codex-plugin/). Parking commit must include all of the Codex files; the W2 plans commit to main as absorbed drafts.
